assessment_policy: Validity, contribution, priority and fertility are separate. Classical FSC/Markov tools enable the operational closure and exact regeneration certificate; assess innovation at the actual coupling and guarantee, not by whether the tools are familiar.

branch_additions.title: Diagnostic-controlled recurrent maintenance with a regenerative physical interface
branch_additions.hypothesis: A shared faulty decision/work bank can maintain itself through physically stored diagnosis and success-funded resources; fresh report generation can yield a policy-uniform stochastic realization without exposing hidden health.
branch_additions.reactivation_trigger: Diagnosis, correction, maintenance and resource renewal have only been tested as separate components, or current health is averaged independently of a stale report.
branch_additions.minimal_test: One six-NAND shared bank, three stored health bits, four resource levels, hidden bank mode, paid startup/operation/service and a16-program stationary library. Compare an independent raw event kernel with a12-phase regenerative evaluator.
branch_additions.acceptance_gate: One recurrent physical/resource process, a strictly separated implementable target, exact kernel certificate and independent oracle; retain fatal-hazard and uninformative-diagnosis controls.
branch_additions.contribution: Executed64-state loop and12-phase stochastic realization;16 complete stationary programs; fair-prior8-cycle survival .917476789649 vs best blind .911531765217, with fewer maintenance attempts. No global history-policy or immortal-agency claim.

branch_updates.evidence: A physically refreshed report determines fallible maintenance; current and report-time health remain correlated. Exact shared-emission factorization closes all fixed-program continuations.
branch_updates.remaining_gate: Compare fresh acquisition versus physical retention under one paid contract and derive the smallest interface when emission closure breaks.
branch_updates.dead_end_trigger: Evaluator health, exact posterior or a one-step quotient is silently granted to runtime memory.
branch_updates.minimal_test: Two memory-update primitives with identical task and ledger; minimal separating history or a certified stochastic realization.

branch_updates.evidence: The same six-NAND bank selects its repair and executes later tasks. Maintenance is charged before work harvest and may fail without a revealed outcome.
branch_updates.remaining_gate: Price alternative routing/acquisition libraries and their failure modes; the current resource guard and routing remain trusted common interfaces.
branch_updates.dead_end_trigger: A maintenance advantage relies on free external triggering, an unused diagnostic charged unfairly to a competing design, or negative intermediate resource.
branch_updates.minimal_test: Two whole recurrent libraries under equal acquisition/service accounting, with a physically attained guarantee and independent blind competitor.

rejected_additions.claim: Current bank health and resource balance suffice even when the diagnostic was written before a possible health change.
rejected_additions.reason: The two phases(v=0,z=1,b=3) and(v=1,z=1,b=3) have identical current health/resources but different stored-report laws and next-cycle transition rows. A stale report is an operationally relevant correlation.

rejected_additions.claim: An uninformative stored report forces the action to be independent of hidden physical bank health.
rejected_additions.reason: With fair independent report cells, the actual voter outputs1 with probabilities .501617015984006 and .5294254592 in healthy/degraded modes. The hardware itself supplies a causal dependence; this is not information in the register.
